name: Small World Coffee
note: Solid coffee, great matcha, and tasty scones to enjoy in a packed cozy cafe full of working students.
story: Countless math psets were done here...

name: MAME Seefeld
note: Amazing specialty coffee in Zürich with a wide selection of beans, commitment to craft, and workspace.
story: The birthplace of my Junior Paper on quantum superconducting circuits and symplectic geometry.

name: Coeur Coffee Roasters
note: Great coffee in a small packed store inthe 18th Arr. of Paris. Great location to get a coffee before strolling around Montmartre.

name: Noir Coffee Shop
note: Refreshing iced latte with an interesting interior design.

name: Frappé Coffee Shop
note: Okay coffee, decent frappe version.

name: Shakespeare and Company Café
note: Mediocre coffee boosted by the nearby famous bookstore.

name: Bäckerei Konditorei Hausammann Zollikon
note: Bakery/coffee open on Sunday in lovely Zollikon, but the coffee is horrible.

name: Babu's Bakery & Coffeehouse
note: Decent coffee and tasty cakes at this relatively famous spot. Matcha was alright too.

name: Einstein & Zweistein
note: You don't go here for the coffee, you go here to study.

name: Kraftwerk
note: Fancy coffee shop built with shipping containers, lots of workspaces.
story: Apparently this place turns into a bar at night?

name: Sphères
note: Fantastic coffee with an indoor book store and outdoor foyer.

name: ViCAFE Rösterei & Kaffeebar
note: Outstanding coffee shop and local roastery with nice architecture and eats.
story: Went on a private roastery tour here.

name: Café het Paleis
note: Beautiful cafe whose coffee and cakes are good, and ambiance is great.

name: Strudel Cafe Kroll
note: The apfelstrudel (apple strudel) overshadows the coffee.

name: Restaurant Charivari in der Vitalwelt Schliersee
note: Okay coffee with good eats and an amazing view.

name: Alumni Quattro Lounge
note: Study spot filled with natural lighting on the ETH Hönggerberg campus.

name: Kolacherie Kampus Hybernská
note: A must try kolache pastry spot, also serving tasty simple coffee.

name: Sweet & Pepper DAYS
note: Solid iced latte with some great brunch sliders.

name: Voyager Craft Coffee - Cupertino
note: Ordered some sort of weird pumpkin spice thing, tasted like sugar water - stick to normal coffees.

name: 33 Coffee (Qinggu Shop)
note: Amazing artisanal dirty coffees on the outskirts of Hangzhou with some good popcorn chicken.
story: Has a special place in my heart since I always visit when seeing family

name: Fiddleheads Menomonee Falls
note: Okay coffee at a cute downtown area with multiple stories of laptop friendly space.
story: Some unnamed individual spilled there entire coffee on the table here.

name: Colectivo Coffee Mequon
note: Modern cozy plant-filled vibe with good coffee and lots of indoor and outdoor seating.

name: Colectivo Coffee Wicker Park
note: The location and fantastic seating/interior-design steals the spotlight from an otherwise decent coffee.

name: Einstein – au jardin –
note: A peaceful coffee in a garden courtyard overlooking the river, cathedral, with some serious bocce ball gameplay.
story: Following the Einstein path of Princeton, ETH, Bern, Berlin combo.

name: Couloir Chamonix
note: Small specialty cafe that makes up for their lackluster interior design with some good smooth coffee.

name: Noir Coffee Shop - Ile Saint-Louis
note: Cafe along the beautiful streets of Ile Saint-Louis with an underground cellar (but the coffee is just okay).

name: BO&MIE Montmartre
note: Average coffee to drink while people-watching.

name: Big Shoulders Coffee - Board of Trade
note: Moreso a place to go for a quick coffee if you work at the Board of Trade. Otherwise, just a plain coffee.

name: Capital One Café
note: Nice place to work and get 50% off verve coffee if you use Capital One.

name: Starbucks Reserve Roastery
note: Crowded touristy starbucks reserve with beautiful design and architecture - just go here once in your life.

name: 85°C Bakery Cafe - Cupertino
note: The pastries here are decent (although fallen off over the years), and the coffee is fine.

name: Caffè Macs - Apple Park
note: A part of the Apple ecosystem I didn't know I needed. Unironically one of the most beautiful cafes in the world.
story: Attached to the Apple park exclusive store, so it might end up being your most expensive cup of coffee.

name: Bitter + Sweet
note: Local hidden-gem with great coffee, famous red-velvet latte, and unique design (they sometimes have pho coffee).

name: CAFE BANDÚ
note: Good food and good coffee, but seems like a hit or miss based on the reviews.

name: Voyager Craft Coffee - CoDa Stanford
note: Cafe in the Computing and Data Science building with lots of study spots. Interesting international themed coffee menu and decent matcha too.

name: Blend
note: Decent premade iced-coffees to go with a fantastic slop bowl.

name: Lutticken's Deli (CSSR cafe)
note: Okay coffee, better bagels.

name: Goddess and the Baker, Corners of Brookfield
note: Really good coffee but not the biggest fan of the outback steakhouse type vibe.

name: Beckman Bistro
note: Go here when you're in a rush only, there are so many better options.

name: Bytes Cafe
note: The quick cafe spot for academics, but the coffee honestly isn't too great. Visited before the remodel.

name: Verve Coffee Roasters
note: Packed verve cafe full of students studying - don't expect to find a seat here.

name: Coupa Cafe - Green Library
note: Classic Stanford meetup and coffee chat spot with valid coffee.

name: CoHo
note: Coffee is not on par, the food is decent. Known for its late night music performances.

name: Blue Bottle Coffee - Ferry Building
note: Tasty coffee chain and reliable NOLA. Perfect for strolling around in the Ferry Building and around the pier.

name: Caffe Central
note: Popular spot whose coffee is sometimes not worth the long wait - solid overall.

name: JOE & THE JUICE - Montgomery
note: Quite an overpriced coffee and juice chain, but consistently has a good working environment.

name: maman
note: Lively brunch and coffee spot with a great secret and seasonal coffee menu.
story: Normally not into sweet coffees but their seasonal blueberry latte was fantastic.

name: Sakrid Coffee Roasters
note: Small, somewhat pricey spot whose coffee is overshadowed by its neighbors.

name: Rojo's Roastery
note: Small lesser-known coffee spot in the area with good service and solid coffee. Great location next to Palmer square.

name: Small World Coffee (Equad)
note: Smaller sibling to their main Witherspoon location; less packed and good for a faster coffee to-go.

name: La Cabra
note: One of the most popular coffee spots in the city, consistently ranked first... worth a visit but doesn't live up to the hype.

name: Justin's Salt Bread
note: Enjoy a good coffee and even better soft bread rolls on tatami mats.

name: Blank Street - NOHO
note: Popular coffee chain in new york whose matcha outshines their mediocre coffee.

name: 787 Coffee - Tribecca
note: Favorite coffee chain in NYC, full of character. They serve iced coffee in bags and have a Puerto Rican-inspired specialty menu.
story: Some may say this place is a little too hip and performative with their "interesting" decor.

name: 787 Coffee - Chelsea
note: Unique and hip coffee spot that can fulfill your performative desire to carry a bag filled with coffee.

name: 787 Coffee - Fidi
note: Local-favorite and personal favorite NYC coffee chain.

name: Blue Bottle Coffee - SOHO
note: Connected to a nearby hotel lounge space; solid NOLA to enjoy while watching the Canal Street fake vendors.

name: Blue Bottle Coffee - Santana Row
note: Vibey outdoor Blue Bottle with occasional farmer's markets and outdoor music performances.

name: VØID
note: The coffee fails to live up to the promise of the shop’s design.

name: Philz Coffee - Main Street Cupertino
note: California-based coffee spot with an overcomplicated but nice coffee menu to help you feel even more performative.

name: Studio Cafe
note: Beautifully crafted coffee right on the Monterey Bay Coastal Trail, with some tasty breakfast.

name: Blue Bottle Coffee - Stanford Shopping
note: NOLA you can count on, well-designed interior.
